select t.id, t.user_id as userId, t.vacation_id as vacationId, t.start_time as startTime, t.end_time as endTime, t.leave_reason as leaveReason, t.leave_picture as leavePicture, t.approval_criteria_id as approvalCriteriaId, t.apprpval_status as apprpvalStatus, vs.vacation_status as vacationStatus, ls.schedule_id as scheduleId from leave_info t left join vacation_set vs on t.vacation_id=vs.id left join leave_schedule ls on t.id=ls.leave_id
t.apprpval_status = 1 and vs.vacation_enable=1
and t.user_id = #{queryForm.userId}
and DATE_FORMAT(t.start_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') between DATE_FORMAT(#{queryForm.betweenDate},'%y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(#{queryForm.andDate},'%y-%m-%d')
order by start_time asc
